name: Perseverance sample sites: sealed cores from NASA's Mars Rock Samples page, placed at the rover's last stop before sealing (within about 300 m)

properties.name: Montdenier (Rochette)
properties.reason: Perseverance's sample 2, sealed on sol 194 at Rochette, Artuby Ridge. NASA lists the rock as: igneous. A core worth reaching if you want the rock the rover chose to keep.
properties.source: NASA Mars Rock Samples (https://science.nasa.gov/mission/mars-2020-perseverance/mars-rock-samples/); position from NASA's Mars 2020 stop list, site 7 drive 0, sol 180
